name: Corona Remedies Ltd
title: Corona Remedies Ltd - 544644 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

summary.headline: Corona Remedies Q4FY26 revenue rose 20.2% to INR 353 crore and FY26 PAT grew 33% (adjusted INR 199 crore), with Q4 EBITDA margin down ~90bps to 17.6%.
summary.overview: Q4FY26 revenue was INR 353 crore (+20.2% YoY) and PAT INR 45 crore (+44% YoY), while EBITDA rose 14.4% to INR 62 crore and margin fell about 90bps to 17.6% due to new divisions, MR additions and R&D spend. For FY26, revenue grew 17.3% to INR 1,403 crore, EBITDA rose 22.3% to INR 293 crore (20.9% margin, +80bps), and adjusted PAT grew 33.4% to INR 199 crore after a one-time labour code charge. Management declared a 100% dividend (INR 2 per share) and guided to 15% organic revenue growth, 25% growth on acquired brands and 20%+ PAT growth in FY27.

financial_highlights.metric: FY26 adjusted PAT (ex one-time labour code impact)

segments.name: India business
segments.commentary: Contributed ~96% of FY26 revenue; India growth 16.8% in FY26 with domestic Q4 growth of 18.3%. Management says it outgrew IPM in volume, price and new launches.

segments.name: International business
segments.commentary: Grew 29.5% in FY26 and 70% in Q4FY26, but is only ~4% of revenue. Operates on a B2B model with lower gross margin and higher EBITDA than India B2C; management targets high-single to low-double digit growth.

segments.name: Chronic and semi-chronic portfolio
segments.commentary: Contributes 72% of revenue per PharmaTrac MAT March 2026 (71.9% in FY26). Two brands crossed INR 100 crore; two brands are in the INR 100-200 crore club and eight in the INR 50-100 crore club.

segments.name: Acquired brands (Bayer portfolio, Wokadine)
segments.commentary: Bayer seven-brand portfolio relaunched in Q4FY26 with an infertility division; Menodac and Fostine R named as focus brands. Wokadine (No. 2 in Indian povidone iodine, ~INR 20 crore revenue) expected to grow ~25% p.a. for 3-4 years with ~400bps gross margin correction in year one.

segments.name: Biosimilars and biologics / Semaglutide
segments.commentary: Three biosimilar launches in FY26 (Fostine R, Tricium DnaB, Wyntide, Tyvenza as named on the call). Semaglutide generics made via MSM as manufacturing partner; Wyntide targets super-specialists and Tyvenza targets tier 2/3 markets.

guidance_outlook: Maintain 15%+ organic revenue growth, 25% growth on acquired brands, and 20%+ PAT growth in FY27 and for the next 2-3 years.
Gross margin expected to be sustained around 80% in coming years, supported by product mix; Middle East/oil-linked API cost risk too early to quantify, with ~90-120 days of inventory on hand.
EBITDA margin expected to improve over time through productivity and operating leverage; management cited 24-25% as a question from an analyst but did not commit to a target.
Expects IPM growth of 10-10.5% in FY27 (volume 1.5-2%), with Corona volume growth of 3x-4x the market.
Bhayla hormone plant and 600-kg line expansion to become operational in Q1 or Q2 FY27; European and Eurasian market revenue expected to build over 2-3 years.
Management says the 15% revenue and 20% PAT framework is unchanged for international business; international expected at 8-9% CAGR over the next 3-4 years.
capex_capacity: Dedicated hormone manufacturing plant (Bhayla) expected operational in Q1 or Q2 FY27; new 600-kg line expansion under way.

EAEU GMP certification received, enabling entry into Russia, Belarus, Kazakhstan, Armenia and Kyrgyzstan; Bhayla plant already EU-approved, with dossier filings in progress and 1.5-2 years needed per country registration.
Working capital for international expansion funded through internal accruals; R&D and bioequivalence studies needed for dossiers.
MR strength at 3,100 after adding ~450 in FY26 (2,630 prior base); management says it is comfortable with current MR strength for FY27.
demand_pricing: IPM grew ~8.6% in FY26 (volume 0.7%); Corona grew volume ~3% (4.6x IPM) and new launches contributed 6.4% (2.6x IPM 2.5%).
PharmaTrac pricing growth reported at ~7.8% per management slide; management attributes this to 92-93% non-NLEM portfolio, with volume outgrowing price.
PCPM rose to INR 4.11 lakh per month from INR 3.62 lakh a year earlier; MR tenure buckets targeted at INR 2 lakh (0-3 yrs), INR 4 lakh (3-6 yrs), INR 6-8 lakh (6+ yrs).
Advertising plus sales promotion ~19% of FY26 sales: ~10% KOL consulting, ~5% S&D promotion, ~4% scientific conferences.
Raw material imports under 1% of RM, so limited direct FX/import exposure; indirect cost pressure from API makers.
Semaglutide first-year India market estimated by management at INR 2,000-2,500 crore (range quoted by analysts INR 500-5,000 crore).

qa_highlights.question: Is 17-18% the right EBITDA margin range, or is 20%+ achievable?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said Q4 margin dip reflected MR and employee additions; FY26 margin was 20.9% (+80bps), and it expects productivity-led improvement, with current MR strength considered sufficient for FY27.

qa_highlights.question: Breakdown of Q4 margin dip and whether Q4 seasonality is structural?
qa_highlights.answer: INR 9 crore employee cost for two new divisions and MRs, INR 5 crore MR allowances in other expenses and INR 1.6 crore R&D (BE) cost; management cited seasonality plus the two new divisions and asked analysts to look at H1 vs H2.

qa_highlights.question: Is the ~7.8% pricing growth sustainable and what is the Middle East impact?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said pricing is sustainable given 92-93% non-NLEM exposure; too early to quantify Middle East/oil impact on gross margin, with 90-120 days of inventory.

qa_highlights.question: What are PCPM, export margin profile and AI use in doctor engagement?
qa_highlights.answer: PCPM is INR 4.11 lakh (vs INR 3.62 lakh); exports carry lower gross margin and higher EBITDA margin under B2B; AI is used in the SFE tool for reps and a diagnosis/prescription tool for doctors.

qa_highlights.question: How will Wokadine and the Bayer brands scale?
qa_highlights.answer: Wokadine expected to grow ~25% for 3-4 years with ~400bps gross margin correction in year one, shifting focus to non-NLEM SKUs; Menodac and Fostine R are the Bayer arrowhead brands, with a target of INR 50-100 crore over the next few years.

qa_highlights.question: Is IPM acceleration sustainable and will volume outperformance hold?
qa_highlights.answer: Management expects IPM at 10-10.5% in FY27 with 1.5-2% volume; Corona expects 3x-4x volume outperformance versus the market, down from the historical 4-5x.

risks_watch: Q4 EBITDA margin at 17.6% after new divisions, MR hiring and R&D; watch whether the margin recovers as the new divisions scale.
API and crude-linked raw material inflation (Middle East) could pressure the ~80% gross margin; management flagged 90-120 days of inventory cover.
Wokadine gross margin correction of ~400bps in year one and possible further 600-700bps; Bayer infertility relaunch progress to be reviewed in 3-4 months.
Semaglutide market size estimates vary widely (INR 500-5,000 crore), and clarity is expected in 2-3 months.
Short-term borrowings of INR 143 crore are overdraft against FDs (net cash ~INR 15 crore) linked to the Wokadine acquisition; a INR 16 crore Myoril loan is to be repaid in FY27.
Export ramp-up depends on 1.5-2 years per country registration; international growth expected at 8-9% CAGR, so near-term contribution stays small.
summary.management_tone: Confident and upbeat on growth and outperformance, reiterating 15%/25%/20% targets for FY27. Cautious and non-committal on the Middle East API cost impact and on EBITDA margin expansion, which management framed as longer-term.
key_quotes: Our philosophy is to grow 15% on a revenue and 20% on a PAT basis on a year-on-year basis for coming 3 to 5 years down the line.
So, we are open for all the things as far as complex, generic, and biologics biosimilar is concemed.
So, it is absolutely sustainable, Alankar.
These are all growth investments which will reap benefits for the future period.

adds.what: Dedicated hormone manufacturing plant (Bhayla) operational in Q1 or Q2 FY27

growth.why: Management guides 15%+ organic revenue growth, 25% on acquired brands and 20%+ PAT growth in FY27, backed by the Bhayla hormone plant and 600-kg line due Q1-Q2 FY27, MR strength at 3,100 (+~450), and volume growth 3-4x IPM; capacity and MR details are concrete but no order book or capacity-utilisation figures were given.
